users.preset.recent7d.tip: Users active within the last 7 days
users.preset.clarity.tip: Users with at least one Clarity recording. This is judged per user, so not every session of a matching user has a recording (check each session on the detail page).
users.preset.multi_session.tip: Users with two or more sessions in the period
users.empty: No users found in this period. Try a different period or filter.
users.empty.stale: No data exists for this period yet. The dataset only goes up to the date below - the upstream daily batch may have stopped.
users.error.bq: The BigQuery request failed. Check the logs or ask your administrator.
segment.label: Segments
segment.save.tip: Give the current filter set a name and save it
segment.export.tip: Export saved segments as JSON, to move them to another computer or share them
segment.import.tip: Import a previously exported JSON file
segment.import.failed: Import failed. Check that the file is valid JSON.
segment.storage_note: Segments are stored only in this browser on this device. To use them elsewhere, or to share them, export them as JSON with "📤 Export".

csv.truncated: ⚠ Stopped at the {rows}-row limit. Narrow the period or filters and try again.

clarity.legend.title: About Clarity recordings
clarity.legend.body: Clarity does not split sessions the way GA4 does (GA4 starts a new session after 30 minutes of inactivity and at midnight; Clarity does not). As a result one recording can be attached to several session rows, and a recording may not match that row's path exactly. To line them up precisely, copy the IDs next to the recording and filter by them inside Clarity.
clarity.open.tip: Open the recording in Clarity in a new window
clarity.list.tip: Opens the Clarity recordings list (this URL form cannot identify a single recording)
clarity.user_id.tip: Clarity user ID. Click to copy it and paste it into a Clarity filter.
clarity.session_id.tip: Clarity session ID. Click to copy.
clarity.shared: ⚠ Same recording as other sessions ({count} in this period)
clarity.shared.tip: Clarity session boundaries do not match GA4's ga_session_id. This recording is attached to {count} GA4 sessions inside the displayed period, so it does not necessarily show only this row. Widening the period can increase this number.
clarity.multi.tip: This session has {count} Clarity recordings attached. Because GA4 and Clarity split sessions differently, no single one necessarily covers the whole session. Use the IDs to line them up inside Clarity.
detail.journey.tip: Show this user's page path, session by session (no LLM involved)
journey.title: Per-user journey
journey.subtitle: The user's micro_user_table events, grouped into sessions and ordered in time. No AI is involved.
journey.observations.note: These are facts derived by fixed rules. Interpretation is left to the analyst.
journey.truncated: ⚠ The display limit ({rows} rows) was reached; later events are not shown.
journey.empty: No events for this user were found in micro_user_table.
journey.obs.same_entry_exit: {count} session(s) entered and exited on the same page (e.g. {path}).
journey.obs.single_page_sessions: {count} of {total} session(s) viewed a single page only.
journey.obs.many_pages_in_session: Session {session_no} viewed {count} pages in one visit.
journey.obs.truncated: Display limit reached: totals cover the first {rows} rows only.
journeys.title: Common journeys
journeys.subtitle: Page views of every session in the period, aggregated into the most common transitions, entry pages, exit pages and route patterns. Rule-based; no AI is involved.
journeys.period.clamped: No data in the last 30 days, so the 30 days ending on the newest event date ({date}) are shown instead.
journeys.truncated: ⚠ The period holds more than {count} sessions; only the newest {count} were counted. Narrow the period.
journeys.empty: No session with a page_view in this period. Change the period.
journeys.transitions.note: Two consecutive pages within one session (A → B), counted once per session.
journeys.sequences.note: Whole session routes (repeated pages collapsed, first {steps} steps only).
journey.timeline.note: One row per page view, with the events that fired while that page was open nested under it (the snowprism timeline layout).
journey.timeline.raw: Show all events as a table
journey.notes.note: Heuristic reading aids produced by fixed rules. Read them as possibilities, not conclusions.
journey.note.organic_search: Arrived from organic search; may be gathering information or comparing options.
journey.note.paid_entry: Arrived from paid traffic ({source} / {medium}); may be checking whether the page matches the ad.
journey.note.task_landing: Landed on {path}, which suggests a return visit to complete a specific task rather than exploration.
journey.note.funnel_purchase: Reached a purchase within this session; the decision was essentially made.
journey.note.funnel_begin_checkout: Reached checkout but did not purchase; intent was high, but a last doubt or form friction may have remained.
journey.note.funnel_add_to_cart: Added to cart; comparison seems well advanced.
journey.note.key_event_after_pages: A key event ({event}) fired after {pages} page views; the action may have followed genuine consideration.
journey.note.key_event_early: A key event ({event}) fired almost immediately on entry; the visitor may have arrived already decided.
journey.note.bounce: Left from the landing page ({path}) only; a mismatch with expectations, or the needed information was not found quickly.
journey.note.deep_session: {pages} pages over {seconds} s; this looks like serious comparison rather than skimming.
journey.note.long_dwell: {path} stayed open for {seconds} s; its content may have been read carefully.
journey.note.returned_to_entry: Returned to the entry page ({path}) after viewing others; may have been comparing or re-checking.
journey.note.scrolled: Scrolled {count} time(s); at least the main content was read.
journey.note.cross_domain: Spans {count} domains; may include a hop to an external service (payment, booking).
journey.note.mobile_quick: A short mobile visit ({seconds} s); possibly a quick check on the move.
journey.note.quick_check: A short session; possibly a quick check or re-check of a specific page.
journey.context.note: A rule-based digest of this journey, built without AI. The optional AI summary receives only this data.
journey.context.gaps.none: Only one session, so there are no gaps.
journey.context.next.note: Pages listed in the tenant's site.key_paths that this user has not viewed.
journey.context.next.none: All key pages reached, or site.key_paths is not configured.
journey.context.device.none: Not available in this dataset (columns missing in the sample).
ai.title: AI summary (optional)
ai.note: Sends only the journey context above and each session's timeline (page paths, times, event names) to {provider} / {model}. The result is a draft for an analyst.
ai.disclaimer: This summary is an AI-generated draft. An analyst must check it against the data before acting on it.
ai.error.ai_disabled: AI summary is not enabled on this install. Set WACA_PATH_AI_PROVIDER and the matching API key to use it; everything else works without AI.
ai.error.ai_rate_limited: The AI summary rate limit (per minute) was reached. Wait a moment and retry.
ai.error.ai_sdk_missing: The AI provider SDK is not installed. Run: pip install -r backend/requirements-ai.txt
ai.error.ai_provider_error: The AI provider call failed. Check the server logs (API keys are never logged).
